title: Hakoniwa Base Ball
description:
You're the general manager — no batting or pitching controls, just the decisions that shape a club. Pick the draft class, work the trade market, renegotiate contracts and keep the books balanced, for one season or for decades.

Sim any game in an instant, or watch it in 3D and make the calls that matter. Dress your league in uniforms and ballparks you designed, and watch your own baseball world take shape.

Watch in 3D — or Skip to the Result

Games play out pitch by pitch, driven by your players' ratings. Sit back and watch, or step in with batting and defensive calls whenever you like.

• Switch cameras: Broadcast, Batter close-up, Batter eyes, Backstop, Bullpen and more

• Compare before and after when you change pitchers, pinch-hit, pinch-run or swap fielders

• Pinch Stop and Chance Stop hand control back to you when the game is on the line

• Set how often each pitcher appears, how long they pitch and when to use them

• Sim straight to the result, or switch to the Classic view of text and numbers

Run the Front Office

Free agency, trades, Contract Renewal and Retirement Talks. Bring a player's numbers to the table, buy out a deal that isn't working, and sign foreign players to fill the gaps. When a star asks to be posted overseas or leaves as an overseas free agent, it's your call how to respond.

Draft and Scouting

What you see of draft prospects and foreign signings is your scouts' estimate. Dig deeper and hire sharper eyes, and the picture gets clearer.

Prospects show up from Opening Day. Meet them, win them over, and if clubs collide on a first-round pick, it goes to a lottery. A player who turns you down may come back years later.

Balance the Books

Ticket prices, sponsors, merchandise and ballpark renovations. Winning builds popularity, and popularity pays off. Prefer to focus on the roster and the dugout? Hand the finances to auto-management.

Build Your League

One to six leagues, up to 30 clubs, starting from a Japanese-style 12-team league. Split them into divisions, add promotion and relegation, or rebuild the whole structure in the offseason. Postseason format, injury frequency and more can be changed even mid-save. A regular International Tournament gives your players a chance to make the national team.

Make It Yours

Design home and visitor uniforms, ballpark exteriors (roof, setting, season), team emblems and player faces, and see them all in 3D matches. Share uniforms with a share code.

Edit players, teams and ballparks in-game, swap in your own sound effects, walk-up music, cheer songs and images, and share mods through Steam Workshop. The Windows full version also includes creation tools such as the Cheer Song Maker.

Use jersey numbers 0 and 00, edit managers' and coaches' faces and gender, and set player injuries before Opening Day. Choose the color and width of the ballpark's batter's eye.

Minigames

Swing for the fences, call balls and strikes, race the relief cart, steal second. Six hands-on minigames, separate from your season, including Home Run Derby, Umpire Challenge and Relief Cart Battle. Pick players from your data and their ratings show in how they play.

A History That Keeps Growing

Players develop, peak, decline and retire, and new generations take their place. Records and the Player Directory fill up with a history that belongs only to your world. After each game day, a Post-game News Show recaps what happened.

Open detailed minor-team game records from the Schedule, and check recent and series stats during the postseason.

Try the free demo: play a full season, and your save carries over to the full game.

From the DeveloperHakoniwa Base Ball is made by a solo developer. Since launch it has added a 3D match view, minigames, uniform and ballpark editors, international tournaments and more. Updates will keep coming, with an ear to what players have to say.

Key features• Pure management: no batting or pitching controls, results driven by player ratings

• Sim games in an instant, or watch and manage them in 3D or the Classic view

• Free agency, trades, contract talks, buyouts and overseas moves

• A draft with interviews, lotteries and scouting estimates that sharpen as you invest

• Run the finances: tickets, sponsors, merchandise and ballpark renovations

• Up to 30 clubs in 6 leagues, with divisions, promotion and relegation, and an International Tournament

• Create uniforms, ballparks, emblems and faces, and edit coaching staff

• Six hands-on minigames, separate from your season

• In-game data editing, custom sounds and images, Steam Workshop and Steam Achievements
description_short: You're the GM of a baseball club inspired by Japanese pro baseball. Draft, trade, scout and sign, then sim games in an instant or call the shots in 3D. Build leagues of up to 30 teams, design your own uniforms and ballparks, and watch generations of players write your league's history.
